findings.message: imported Solid package "uncontracted-package" has no reactivity contract; solid-checker cannot rely on its export summaries, so every use of them is uncertifiable
findings.hint: Create a local contract at <ROOT>/fixtures/reactive-ir/no-owner-v1/.solid-checker/contracts/uncontracted-package/solid-reactivity.json, or pass one explicitly with --contract <PATH>. If you maintain uncontracted-package, ship solid-reactivity.json in the package root so every consumer gets it. See docs/package-contracts.md for the format.

findings.message: effect is created without a reactive owner; nothing will ever dispose it, so it keeps running and holding its subscriptions for the lifetime of the app
findings.hint: Create effects inside a component or computation so their owner disposes them. For deliberate module-scope reactivity, wrap the setup in createRoot(dispose => ...) and keep the dispose handle.

findings.message: boundary is created without a reactive owner; it can never be disposed, and the subtree it manages will leak
findings.hint: Render boundaries inside a component tree rooted by render() or hydrate(), or under an explicit createRoot; a boundary created in a bare helper function has no owner to attach to.

findings.message: effect is created without a reactive owner; nothing will ever dispose it, so it keeps running and holding its subscriptions for the lifetime of the app; the containing function may be a Solid component or an ordinary helper, so its owner context cannot be certified
findings.hint: Create effects inside a component or computation so their owner disposes them. For deliberate module-scope reactivity, wrap the setup in createRoot(dispose => ...) and keep the dispose handle. Use the function through JSX or annotate it with Solid's Component type to establish component ownership; otherwise handle the helper's lifetime explicitly.
